inputs.text: This looks less like ordinary inaction and more like a system protecting its own interests. KTR says the Congress government is doing nothing about illegal mining while Raghava Constructions—alleged to belong to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy—is involved. And the account cuts off right as the Sircilla MLA is questioning something. That missing piece feels deliberate: when the question points toward a minister’s company, keeping people from hearing it is part of the cover.
